answer: A sybil-resistant economy can bind each identity to a single-use seal renewed every epoch. The agent holds an onyx attestation and, to act, spends it on one fresh challenge while presenting the relic of the previous seal. A copy reuses an already-spent seal, so both claims are voided and the bonds behind them burn. An oasis of shared implants cannot present one seal twice, so every extra key must genuinely reproduce a distinct device.
